_comment: AGENT: always read this file via the task-index-manager skill before reading or writing any task state. System tracker for ai-worldbuilder (ADR 002). Never add tasks for individual worlds here

tasks.title: Trees layer reads mapped tree points and tree rows from the vector map
tasks.notes: Cause: OSMGround collects natural=tree points into .trees but no layer reads them; trees_layer takes lidar canopy plus the hand-read crown files only. natural=tree_row lines are not read at all. Deliver: use mapped tree points and tree rows as candidate crown positions in trees_layer (snap to lidar canopy peaks as #129 does; log each rejected point with its reason); tree_row lines laid as a crown sequence. Needs #156 so the points are fetched. Proof: unit test with a fixture cell holding three tree points and a canopy raster; every point inside the cell yields a crown or a logged rejection. No live-world test. Helps: any cell with surveyed trees, all worlds. REVIEW 2026-10-27: say whether mapped tree points with no lidar canopy peak (young trees) are kept as small crowns or rejected with a logged reason. Unblocked 2026-10-27: #156 done. WAVE2 2026-10-27: claimed by orchestrate-rest. WAVE3 2026-10-27: orchestrate-rest continues.

tasks.title: Ground reads pitch, playground, construction and allotment areas and their surface tag
tasks.notes: Cause: OSMGround._poly reads garden and park (as grass) and wood and scrub, and ignores leisure=pitch, playground, track, landuse=construction, allotments and natural=wetland, grassland, shrubbery; surface=* on polygons is not read either. Deliver: map these tags to a ground kind and priority, choosing the floor from surface and sport where tagged (e.g. tartan, asphalt, grass); keep landuse=residential, retail, commercial, industrial unread (they must not paint under houses). Proof: unit tests in the OSMGround fixture style, one row per tag asserting kind and priority. No live-world test. Helps: any cell with sports pitches, playgrounds or building sites, all worlds. Unblocked 2026-10-27: #156 done. WAVE3 2026-10-27: orchestrate-rest continues.

tasks.title: Building evidence carries roof, height and mapped entrance tags to the designer
tasks.notes: Cause: roof:shape, roof:levels and height are in the cached building clips but only building:levels is read (lidar_heightmap.map_levels); entrance=* points are not fetched, and the facade plan (#145) lists entrances from photos only. Deliver: put roof:shape, roof:levels and height in the feature evidence table as hints beside lidar (never an override); fetch entrance points and offer them as candidate door positions snapped to the footprint edge, ranked main before service and emergency. Proof: evidence-table unit tests with a fixture footprint carrying those tags, and a snap test for an entrance node. No live-world test. Helps: any building with mapped tags, all worlds. Unblocked 2026-10-27: #156 done. WAVE2 2026-10-27: claimed by orchestrate-rest. WAVE3 2026-10-27: orchestrate-rest continues.

tasks.title: Water-body candidates carry the mapped way id and source, and streams are not proposed as ponds
tasks.notes: Split from #156; premise corrected on review. cell_features.missing_water_bodies already feeds OSMGround.water to water_body_components, so nothing needs to be handed over. Real gaps: OSMGround keeps only columns, so a candidate's refs are synthetic water_<x>_<z> and cannot name the mapped way; the candidate provenance source is not set to vector_map (not found where it would be set); stream and drain line columns merge into pond components and are labelled pond. Deliver: polygon water and line water are kept as separate sources in OSMGround; water-body candidates carry the OSM way id and provenance source vector_map; stream lines are not proposed as ponds. Files: lib/sources/ground_sources.py (keep way ids for polygons), lib/builds/water_body.py, lib/journal/cell_features.py, lib/journal/test_cell_features.py. Proof: unit test with a fixture clip holding a natural=water polygon (way 141657072 style id) and a stream line: one candidate with that way id and source vector_map, and no candidate from the stream. No live-world test. Blocked by #162 so culverts do not become ponds; #156 is needed only for the live effect (the pool is fetched), not for the fixture test. Helps: the pond in 48,-45 (I-014), any cell with ponds or fountains. Unblocked 2026-10-27: #162 done. WAVE2 2026-10-27: claimed by orchestrate-rest. WAVE3 2026-10-27: orchestrate-rest continues.

tasks.title: Planned double doors land as two leaves on a stepped wall
tasks.notes: Split from #164 review. Cause: on stepped walls the second leaf needs a lateral neighbour cell that is wall at b and b+1; pairing across a step (diagonal-adjacent cell) is refused by the frame guard and would put the two leaves in different planes, so do not do that. Seen 2026-10-27: west 40-A/40-B, susu 42-C, retail 57-A plan double and land single. Deliver: after #164 builds the jamb, plan_doors pairs leaves laterally only and builds the step block at the shared step. Files: lib/builds/feature_build.py, lib/builds/test_feature_build.py. Proof: stepped-wall fixture: a double entrance gives two leaves in one plane with door_frame_issues empty; a fixture with no lateral room still falls back to one leaf with the 'no pair cell' line. No live-world test. Helps: every building not aligned to the grid, all worlds. Unblocked 2026-10-27: #164 done. WAVE3: claimed for #165.

tasks.title: Remove dead PIT_MAX_WIDTH from ground_layer
tasks.notes: Raised 2026-10-27 in review. PIT_MAX_WIDTH (lib/layers/ground_layer.py) is unused since d812f7c replaced the bbox width gate with PIT_MAX_RADIUS (Chebyshev radius <= 2); it is kept only for one assertion in lib/layers/test_ground_layer.py and reads as a claim that pits are at most N wide. Only do this if the current ground work has not already removed it. Deliver: delete PIT_MAX_WIDTH; make the wide-depression test assert on _pit_chebyshev_radius > PIT_MAX_RADIUS instead. Files: lib/layers/ground_layer.py, lib/layers/test_ground_layer.py. Proof: python3 scripts/run_tests.py --only test_ground_layer passes; grep PIT_MAX_WIDTH finds nothing. Related idea, not filed: gate pit fill on evidence (footprint adjacency, lidar/OSM says no real cutting or pond) instead of the size proxy, which cannot tell a wide artefact from a wide real depression.
